Finite battery DC energy connects through a bidirectional converter to an explicit AC boundary and load. Cooling/control is a separate auxiliary system.

**Model contract:** `scada-placeholder-model` v2. **Diagram contract:** `scada-system` v1.
This pair contains 12 equipment records, 14 declared connections and 3 focused views of one shared model.

## Equipment and model roles

Roles below are the actual records in this scenario. A shared family name does
not imply a calibrated device equation. Circuit roles describe resource bookkeeping;
energy roles describe declared supply/conversion/load relationships.

<details>
<summary>Inspect the 12 equipment records and model roles</summary>

| Equipment ID and label | Symbol | Model / declared domains |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `battery` · Finite stored DC energy | `battery` | `energy-storage`; energy: store |
| `converter` · Bidirectional battery converter | `power-inverter` / `bidirectional` | `power-converter`; energy: converter |
| `bay` · Bidirectional AC collection bay | `hv-circuit-breaker` | `switch`; energy: relay |
| `gridImport` · Explicit grid-import boundary | `transformer` | `processor`; energy: source |
| `gridExport` · Explicit grid-export acceptance | `motor` | `load`; energy: load |
| `station` · Explicit station-service boundary | `transformer` | `processor`; energy: source |
| `plc` · Shared plant controller | `plc-rack` | `controller`; energy: load |
| `dcService` · Explicit station AC/DC service | `power-rectifier` | `power-converter`; energy: converter |
| `coolant` · Battery-cooling inventory | `tank` | `storage`; water: cooling-water (storage) |
| `coolingPump` · Cooling circulation | `pump` / `water` | `pump`; process: cooling-water (passage); energy: load |
| `radiator` · Battery heat rejection | `cooling-radiator` | `heat-rejection`; coolant: cooling-water (passage); air: air (passage); energy: load; retained heat |
| `acBus` · Common AC bus · import / storage / export | `busbar` / `bidirectional` | `processor`; energy: relay |

</details>

## Editable assumptions

The complete scenario and per-component assumptions are in [model.json](model.json).
Reference provenance and authored-layout declarations are in [system.json](system.json).
Key scope statements from this model:

- All sources, sinks, and environmental inputs are explicitly declared. Model values are normalized indices, not plant operating predictions.
- Structural references support equipment roles and separate circuit relationships. Every parameter, display rating and layout is an editable illustrative assumption.
- Each view reads one external model. View selection and inspector use do not create a new physics island or change time.
- This conceptual factory model has no calibrated engineering, protection or nuclear-operation meaning. Replace the model through the adapter contract for real-system integration.

See the [power reference notes](https://github.com/Valpatel/cad-agent/blob/dev/software/cadagent/webkit/scada/ui/docs/POWER_REFERENCES.md) for the
structural sources and their limits. Reference-backed topology does not validate model numbers.

## Authored experiments

The [catalog entry](../index.json) stores each recipe, expected observation and
limitation. These are editable playground commands, not operating procedures.
Run or step the shared model to observe time-dependent effects.

<details>
<summary>Inspect 6 experiment recipes and commands</summary>

| Experiment | Commands |
| --- | --- |
| Stop Explicit grid-import boundary (`stop-source`) | `setEnabled(equipment="gridImport", value=false)` |
| Fault Bidirectional AC collection bay (`inject-fault`) | `setFault(equipment="bay", value=true)` |
| Isolate Bidirectional AC collection bay (`isolate-output`) | `setOpen(equipment="bay", value=true)` |
| Raise the selected stage demand (`stress-stage`) | `setParameter(equipment="gridImport", key="capacity", value=25)`; `setLoad(equipment="gridImport", value=95)` |
| Discharge finite storage (`discharge`) | `setEnabled(equipment="gridImport", value=false)`; `setMode(equipment="converter", value="forward")`; `setMode(equipment="battery", value="discharge")` |
| Charge finite storage (`charge`) | `setEnabled(equipment="gridImport", value=true)`; `setMode(equipment="converter", value="reverse")`; `setMode(equipment="battery", value="charge")` |

</details>
